About Plum Catering

Plum Catering is a Riyadh-based catering and food-industry brand serving organisations, families and foodservice businesses. Our work brings together carefully planned menus, a professional central kitchen and dependable service teams, so that every client receives food prepared to the same standard whether it is a meeting lunch, a large celebration or a recurring bakery order. We take time to understand each brief, recommend what will work for your guests and setting, and stay in contact from first enquiry to final service.

Our Approach

Listen first, plan carefully, prepare with discipline and serve with warmth — the same principles applied to every order.

Frequently Asked Questions

Select "Request a Quote" on any page and tell us about your event or requirement, including the date, number of guests and location. Our team will review the details and contact you to discuss a proposal.

Plum Catering operates from its central kitchen in Riyadh. Please include your location in your request and we will confirm whether we can serve it.

Lead times depend on the size of the event, the menu and the season. We recommend contacting us as early as possible, especially for weddings, large corporate events and Ramadan.

Our service teams plan each event according to its guest count and format. Share your expected numbers in the quote form and we will advise on the best service style.
